title: In-Memory Hash Join
hints: Build phase: index the right side in a dict key -> list of rows (a list, because keys can repeat). Probe phase: walk the left side in order.
A left row that matches several right rows produces several output rows (cross product), exactly like SQL.
SQL semantics: NULL never equals NULL. A None key must not match anything; with how='left' it still produces one row padded with None.
